name: draftcheck
description: Find AI-writing patterns ("AI slop") in prose. Deterministic linter, not an AI detector.

interface.longDescription:
DraftCheck (formerly SlopScore) checks writing for about 20 patterns people associate with AI drafts, such as not-X-but-Y contrasts, dramatic one-line closers, chatbot leftovers, stock vocabulary and em-dash overuse. It returns a 0-100 score and points to each flagged phrase with a fix hint.

The rules are public and the same text always gets the same score. It flags phrasing, not authorship: it can't tell who or what wrote a text.
defaultPrompt: Check my README for AI-writing patterns
